organizations.name: Pilot
organizations.position: Regional Rep, San Francisco · Aug 2013 - Present
organizations.description:
Pilot (http://gopilot.org) is a national organization run by volunteer college students that holds hands-on educational events for high schoolers, bringing together students from all backgrounds and all levels of proficiency in programming. Students form teams, brainstorm ideas, work together to bring one of those ideas to life with technology, and then demo and pitch the apps/websites they created for awards and prizes. We engage the local community by bringing in engineers and designers who mentor these students over the course of a day and help them bring their ideas to life.

I was part of the organizing team for a Pilot event we held at SAP in Palo Alto (http://sf.gopilot.org/), where we partnered with NFTE, the Network for Teaching Entrepreneurship, to bring 60 high schoolers from low income schools and around 40 from other surrounding neighborhoods to SAP for a day to form teams and build apps. We brought in around 30 mentors and 5 prestigious judges to award prizes in many categories. For many students, it was their first real introduction to programming and to pitching a prototype of an idea to an audience.
